transcript.message: We’re making our opening bid of 40.5M for Silva.
We’re not interested in that low-ball offer; our asking price is significantly higher.
We’re increasing our offer to 42M with the possibility of add-ons to make it more attractive.
Their offer is still below our expectations, and with Eastgate also in the race, they need to step up.
We’re looking for a higher figure than 7.8M, especially with Eastgate United also in the mix.
We’re confident in our offer of 4.8M a year on a 5-year deal.
We’re pushing for a deal now, and our best offer is 63M.
Our stance remains firm — we’re not moving on these terms.
We’re not interested in another offer at this stage.
We’re not holding back — 6.6M is our final offer for the personal terms.
We need this done before the deadline, so we’re finalizing our 45M offer with add-ons.
We’re ready to move on the personal terms with 6.3M a year for four years.
We’re happy to accept the 45M offer with add-ons and move forward.
We’re pleased to accept the 6.3M a year for four years.
